methodology.callback_policy: Compiled verbatim callback admission lambda and delegated Inventory, People and Chat predicates; string LLSD parameter only. Dynamic substitutions remain unresolved.
methodology.status_meaning: admitted/excluded refers to startup admission only, never proof of functional integration; non-menu callbacks are dynamic because their direct binding is not gated by menu policy.
methodology.registration_conditions: All preprocessor branches inventoried with condition context; counts are source occurrences, not one platform runtime registry.
scope_limits: Widget helper methods and custom builder internals not executed; widget_status identifies direct type admission or unresolved helper/custom builder.
XUI overlay occurrences retained individually; this inventory does not execute language/skin overlay merge geometry.
Shared permissions, selection, RLVa, maturity, hardware constraints and account lifecycle are legitimate dynamic policies; no expectation that all controls are always enabled.
No real-account or interactive visual qualification performed by this audit.

dependency_families.parcel_places_landmark: Reuse authenticated parcel/region data, selection and mutation services; wire existing Places/Land controllers and landmark persistence without GL scene ownership.
dependency_families.map_radar_tracking: Provide native region/avatar/parcel snapshots, shared tracking/map protocol models, Vulkan map/minimap drawing, and existing spatial list controllers.
dependency_families.appearance_attachment_animation: Connect VSNativeAppearance, native attachment/avatar handles and animation transactions to shared clothing/outfit/gesture controls; provide native previews and permission state.
dependency_families.selection_build_object_task: Provide native object selection/properties/permissions, simulator operations and completion, task inventory and native tool/preview rendering for shared object/build controllers.
dependency_families.environment_graphics: Wire actual native renderer capabilities/settings observers, environment/day-cycle consumption and previews; reuse shared preferences/presets models.
dependency_families.capture_share: Production native scene/UI readback and capture lifecycle, correct size/orientation/color, encoding and shared snapshot/save/upload/share controllers.
dependency_families.voice_spatial: Connect shared call/channel/device controllers and native spatial participant data, retaining actual voice/mute/permission policy.
dependency_families.sound_media: Connect native sound trigger/emitter/parcel/object-media ownership to existing audio/media controllers; distinguish local audition from simulator sound triggering.
dependency_families.economy_commerce: Connect shared balance/benefits/account/browser/economy transactions; object/land commerce also requires native selection and parcel services.
dependency_families.moderation_estate_experience: Native authenticated region/estate permissions, capability/message requests/replies and report/capture ownership; reuse shared moderation/report models.
dependency_families.camera_movement: Route shared camera/movement actions to VSNativeSession/VSNativeCamera, with normal focus/input/restrictions and reference sensitivity/limits.
dependency_families.account_chat_inventory_ui: Reuse existing shared CPU/account/chat/inventory controller; audit nested factories/observers and lifecycle rather than blanket native exclusion.
dependency_families.debug_developer_test: Review whether operation is CPU-only or needs native renderer diagnostics; preserve ordinary intentional debug/hardware/permission policies.
